workflowSteps: 1. Query tasks.json for next unblocked task (status=pending, all deps completed)
3. Retrieve prompt from Guidelines.md using guidelinesRef
4. Validate requirements from Requirements.md using requirementsRef
13. If failure: increment attemptCount, log lastError, execute onFailure.recoveryCommand if defined

queries.getNextTask: jq '.phases[].sections[].tasks[] | select(.status=="pending") | select(all(.dependencies[]; . as $dep | any(.. | .tasks[]?; select(.id==$dep).status=="completed"))) | .id' tasks.json | head -1
queries.getPhaseProgress: jq '[.phases[] | {phase: .name, completed: ([.sections[].tasks[] | select(.status=="completed")] | length), total: .totalTasks}]' tasks.json
queries.getAgentWorkload: jq '[.phases[].sections[].tasks[] | select(.stateTracking.agentAssigned != null) | {agent: .stateTracking.agentAssigned, task: .id}] | group_by(.agent)' tasks.json
